definitions.explanation: An involuntary, sudden contraction of muscles, often painful.
A more severe form of involuntary muscle contractions, often associated with medical conditions like epilepsy or fever.

⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{痙攣|けいれん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
MEDICAL TERM:
{痙攣|けいれん} covers a range of involuntary muscle contractions from minor cramps to serious convulsions.

TYPES:
- ⟦{筋|きん}→筋：noentry⟧{痙攣|けいれん}: Muscle spasm/cramp
- ⟦{熱性|ねっせい}→熱性：30423_nessei⟧{痙攣|けいれん}: Febrile seizure (in children with fever)
- ⟦てんかん→てんかん：noentry⟧⟦{発作|ほっさ}→発作：15023_hossa⟧: Epileptic seizure

COMMON LOCATIONS:
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧: Leg (most common for exercise-related cramps)
- ⟦{ふくらはぎ}→ふくらはぎ：noentry⟧: Calf (also called ⟦こむら{返|がえ}り→こむら返り：29527_komuragaeri⟧)
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧: Around the eye (stress-related twitching)
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧: Hand

VERB USAGE:
- {痙攣|けいれん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a spasm/convulsion
- {痙攣|けいれん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to have a convulsion/seizure

CAUSES:
- ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧: Exercise (muscle cramps)
- ⟦{脱水|だっすい}→脱水：10926_dassui⟧: Dehydration
- ⟦{電解質|でんかいしつ}→電解質：29528_denkaishitsu⟧⟦{異常|いじょう}→異常：01716_ijou⟧: Electrolyte imbalance
- ⟦{疲労|ひろう}→疲労：13603_hirou⟧: Fatigue
- ⟦{高熱|こうねつ}→高熱：14649_kounetsu⟧: High fever (especially in children)

MEDICAL WARNING:
If convulsions are accompanied by loss of consciousness, last more than a few minutes, or occur repeatedly, seek emergency medical care.
